patterns.note: Sections often feature full-width dark backgrounds with large, high-contrast text and imagery, frequently using overlapping elements like large floral graphics and oversized typography.
The site heavily utilizes extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography for hero and section titles, often allowing it to overlap or interact with background imagery.
A high-contrast palette of deep blacks and bright whites is consistently accented with vibrant, almost neon, pinks and greens for CTAs, underlines, and specific textual highlights.

The sticky navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid dark background from its initial transparent state. Sections and large text blocks reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Content sections are delineated by alternating between solid dark backgrounds, dark backgrounds with integrated large-scale photography, and full-bleed vibrant pink backgrounds.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations, likely using css-keyframes, are employed to reveal content sections and large text elements with a staggered fade-up effect as they scroll into view. The sticky header dynamically adjusts its height and background opacity based on scroll position. A subtle parallax effect is applied to the hero background image, making it scroll slower than the foreground content.
Typography is layered and oversized, with large display text often positioned to partially obscure or be partially obscured by background imagery, creating a dynamic and artistic composition.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display text (~8x body) with large, bold headings (~3x body) and standard readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and main sections, balanced within content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic interplay of massive, bold, uppercase typography with lush, dark floral photography, creating an almost editorial and artistic feel. The high-contrast palette, punctuated by unexpected neon accents, further enhances this unique, personal brand aesthetic.
